description: Ateliers d'autoréparation de vélo is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap. Export OpenStreetMap des ateliers d'autoréparation de vélo dans l'Eurométropole de Strasbourg. Ce jeu de données est collaboratif, il est possible de corriger ou compléter son contenu directement dans OpenStreetMap avec un outil d'édition thématique comme MapComplete - Cyclofix. Les occurrences dont l'attribut "id" est vide sont issues d'une mise à jour complémentaire. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are outils, Strasbourg, velo. The portal shows 11 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
